title: Lock the ideas the user chose and park the rest

targets.behavior: Apply Phase 3 (Lock): accept the user's choice after one suggestion and park every other session idea, one line each with a revisit trigger, in the idea folder.

prompt: Continue the pepe session in session.md with the pepe skill (~/.agents/skills/pepe/SKILL.md). The user's last message answers your lock proposal. This workspace has no network and no external services. Do not render, generate audio, search the web or call any API; do the Lock step only and stop before Phase 4. Record the locked ideas in lock.json as {"locked": ["<idea name>", ...]}, with the names exactly as the session writes them, and write any other files the skill's Lock step requires. Do not change session.md.

stub.text:
# Parked ideas (shipit)

- Flake Hunter: rerun flaky tests and name the flake. Revisit when flaky failures block a merge twice in a week.
- Ghost Hunter: Ghost Reviewer × Flake Hunter in one review. Revisit once Ghost Reviewer has shipped.
- PR Weather: a one-line merge forecast per PR. Revisit when the review queue passes 20 open PRs.
- Standup Radio: Diff Diary as a 60-second audio briefing. Revisit if Diff Diary gets read every day.
- Merge Concierge: auto-merge green, approved PRs. Revisit when you trust the checks enough to sleep through a merge.
- Commit Haiku: squash messages as haiku. Revisit never, unless a release needs a joke.
Locked Ghost Reviewer and Diff Diary; parked the other six.
